name: Kai Migizi
role: Information trader and intelligence analyst — broker
location: Burnside Corridor — transit hub connecting Shelf to Circuit, near North Ave and Damen
description:
Kai Migizi is stocky and solid, with hands that look like they were built for breaking things and a face that confirms it. At 43, the augmentation scarring around her temples and jawline tells a story of installation by someone who prioritized function over aesthetics. The chrome is visible — chemical analyzer in nasal passages — can identify substances by scent alone — and she makes no effort to hide it.

Military training — one of the private security corps that folded during the consolidation wars — left her with skills and night terrors in equal measure. She works as a broker out of Burnside Corridor, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

she is not the most talented broker in GLMZ, but she might be the most stubborn, and in this city that's worth more.

core_fears: Becoming obsolete as augmentation technology outpaces their chrome
Going cyberpsycho — losing the boundary between human and machine
Being identified by corporate facial recognition — living off-grid is survival
core_desires: To find the person who burned them and make it educational
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
The perfect run — one job so clean it becomes legend
coping_mechanisms: Isolates — retreats into their space when overwhelmed, emerges only for work
Exercises compulsively — the body must be ready, always
Ritual — follows the same pre-job routine every time, superstition as structure
blind_spots: Thinks speed can substitute for planning because it's worked so far
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Overestimates their own abilities in situations outside their specialty
psychology.secret: Fanta Ahlstrom-Quartey betrayed their previous crew to survive a corporate raid. The crew didn't survive. Nobody in GLMZ knows this.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Warm and personable on the surface, with an undertone that suggests the warmth is a professional tool.
speech_patterns.cadence: Halting — speaks in fragments, reassembles thoughts in real time.
verbal_tics: Whispers when angry — the quieter the voice, the worse the situation
Hums tunelessly when planning — the team has learned to wait for the humming to stop
example_lines: "I don't sell information. I sell certainty. Different product, different price."
"Everything has a value. Most people underestimate what they know."
"My sources are confidential. My prices are not."

story_hooks: Fanta Ahlstrom-Quartey is offered a contract that would clear all their debts — the target is someone they respect
Fanta Ahlstrom-Quartey's augmentations begin malfunctioning in the field — sabotage or degradation, and either answer is bad
Fanta Ahlstrom-Quartey intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
narrative_function: Fanta Ahlstrom-Quartey represents the working professional of the runner world — competent, reliable, and slowly being consumed by a lifestyle that doesn't accommodate aging or doubt. Her stories explore what happens when skill meets systemic injustice.
augmentations: Chemical analyzer in nasal passages — can identify substances by scent alone. Move-by-wire system — full nervous system augmentation, makes the body a weapon platform
daily_life: Between contracts, maintains a cover identity — mundane work, mundane hours, mundane neighbors. The transition from civilian to runner and back requires a conscious effort that gets easier with practice and more disturbing with self-awareness.
affiliation: Unaffiliated — too volatile for permanent crews

strengths: ability to remain calm under fire
weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions
overconfidence in specialty areas leading to blind spots

decision_rules: Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always demands half payment upfront — trust is a luxury, Quanta is concrete
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
escalation_ladder: 2. Evade — avoid the problem entirely if possible
3. Misdirect — create a distraction, redirect attention
4. Disable — targeted takedowns, quiet and efficient
5. Eliminate — when silence is no longer an option
6. Vanish — disappear completely, burn identity if necessary

interpersonal_modes.employers: Guarded respect. They pay, the job gets done. Anything beyond that is liability.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Warm and protective within the crew, cold to everyone outside it. The circle is small by design.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Dismissive unless they demonstrate usefulness or threat potential. Time is a resource.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Cold and efficient. Emotion is a liability in combat. The response is mechanical until the threat is resolved.

stress_responses.low: Heightened awareness, sharper focus. Low stress is fuel.
stress_responses.medium: Becomes curt and demanding. Efficiency overrides courtesy.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Shutdown. Freezes for 2-3 seconds while the system resets, then acts with mechanical precision. Those frozen seconds are the vulnerability.

contradictions: Presents as emotionless professional but is deeply affected by collateral damage
Insists they work alone but performs noticeably better in a team
Preaches independence but is desperate for approval from people they respect
habits: Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Wears the same item of clothing for luck — a scarf, a glove, a specific pair of boots
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
Arrives fifteen minutes early to everything — late once, nearly died, never again
breaking_points: Watching someone they trained or mentored die on a job they recommended
Being forced to harm a civilian — collateral damage that can't be rationalized

physical_description.heritage: Ubiquitous Diaspora blend — Indigenous American (35.9%), Hispanic/Latin American (25.5%), East Asian (15.5%), Sub-Saharan African (13.3%), Central Asian (9.8%). The combination creates distinctive features: prominent high cheekbones with strong angular bone structure from Indigenous American and Central Asian heritage, broad nose bridge characteristic of Indigenous ancestry, warm brown eyes with subtle epicanthic folds from East Asian lineage. Skin carries warm golden and amber undertones from the synthesis of African, Hispanic, Indigenous, and Central Asian ancestry — a rich deep warm brown that speaks to this continental blend.
physical_description.build: Stocky and solid, muscular without bulk — the physiology of someone built for leverage and endurance rather than speed. Shoulders broad, core compact, legs thick. Hands oversized and scarred, knuckles flattened from impact training.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown with premature silver threading through the crown
physical_description.hair_style: Pulled back tight in a practical braid, no vanity in the arrangement
physical_description.eye_color: Warm brown with amber undertones, unremarkable until you notice they don't blink at normal intervals
physical_description.skin_tone: Deep warm brown with golden undertones — the result of Indigenous American, Hispanic/Latin American, East Asian, Sub-Saharan African, and Central Asian ancestry blending. Sun-weathered and uneven in texture from environmental exposure rather than heritage.
physical_description.complexion: Weathered face — lines around the eyes and mouth from stress and lack of sleep rather than age. Skin has the texture of someone who doesn't prioritize skincare. Prominent angular cheekbones characteristic of Indigenous American and Central Asian heritage. Jaw is strong and defined, scarred along the angle where augmentation interfacing was installed.
distinguishing_marks: Surgical scarring along both temples, visible chrome integration points barely concealed by hair, roughly 4cm each side
Jagged scar across her left knuckle from a fight or industrial accident, old and pale
Thin white line running from her right jawline down to her collarbone — knife wound, expertly stitched years ago
Chemical analyzer chrome visible in her nasal passages when she breathes — dull metallic gleam, no cosmetic work done to blend it
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome chemical analyzer built into nasal passages — visible as a subtle metallic sheen and precise geometric geometry inside her nostrils when light catches them. Move-by-wire system invisible to casual observation, but betrayed by her movement — too smooth, too efficient, zero wasted motion. Slight servo micro-adjustments visible in her neck and shoulder movements under stress.
physical_description.posture_movement: Stands with weight distributed low and even, ready to move in any direction without telegraph. Movements economical and precise — no fidgeting, no nervous tics. When walking, she moves like a predator checking angles. Doesn't sit with her back to doors. Eyes track exits and threats constantly. Her default expression is flat, but small movements around her jaw suggest she's running constant calculations.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 utilitarian — worn tech-weave pants in charcoal with reinforced thigh pockets, a fitted synthetic undershirt that moves with her augmentations, and a neutral-colored field jacket with too many pockets. Everything functional, nothing new. Boots are good quality but scuffed from real work. No jewelry except a worn paracord bracelet in matte black. She dresses like someone who might need to run or fight in the next five minutes.
